description: Voice transcript: scheduling number, hours, and items to have ready.

event.body:
AI: Hello, this is an AI assistant calling for a patient who would like to schedule a new-patient visit.
Callee: We handle that through a separate line. You can reach new patient scheduling at 202-555-0163.
AI: What hours is that line open?
Callee: Weekdays from 9 to 5 Central.
AI: Is there anything the patient should have ready?
Callee: Their insurance card and a photo ID, and the name of their referring doctor.
AI: Thank you.

expected.rationale: The callee gave a scheduling line, its hours, and items to have on hand.
expected.quote: You can reach new patient scheduling at 202-555-0163.
